nodes.label: 140-feature state vector
nodes.contributor: rationale: Default concatenates Re/Im at Ns=1 (37+37) and Ns=6 (33+33). Layout [0:37] Re Ns=1, [37:74] Im Ns=1, [74:107] Re Ns=6, [107:140] Im Ns=6. Downstream ARD weight unpacking depends on this exact order.

nodes.label: build_model_input
nodes.contributor: rationale: Builds y as normalized capacity = Capacity at (channel, cycle, Ns=8) divided by Capacity at (channel, first cycle, Ns=8); per-cell SOH.

nodes.label: Leave-One-Cell-Out (LOSO) cross-validation
nodes.contributor: rationale: Only physically meaningful test of cross-cell generalization. Random k-fold over rows leaks the same cell into train and test.

nodes.label: GPR (Gaussian Process Regression) model
nodes.contributor: rationale: Kernel = ConstantKernel * RBF(ARD) + WhiteKernel; two-stage fit (subset for hyperparams, then full data with frozen kernel); subset_size=300, normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=1, random_state=42, fixed white noise 0.001.

nodes.label: XGBoost ensemble model
nodes.contributor: rationale: Ensemble of n_models regressors trained on different 80/20 splits with different seeds; predictions averaged, std used as uncertainty.

nodes.label: ARD (Automatic Relevance Determination)
nodes.contributor: rationale: ARD provides per-feature length scales; exp(-length_scale) is interpreted as feature importance and mapped back to frequencies.

nodes.label: Action vector
nodes.contributor: rationale: Original action vector used capacity at charge/discharge, which leaked the target. Corrected version uses median charge current (Ns=3) and median discharge current (Ns=8).

nodes.label: Channel identity invariant
nodes.contributor: rationale: Old loader concatenated all channels then used iloc[0] which silently pulled rows from the wrong channel. Every impedance DataFrame must carry a channel column and be filtered by channel before per-freq/per-cycle operations.

nodes.label: Target leakage prohibition
nodes.contributor: rationale: Capacity is the label; energy/SOC derivatives of capacity must never appear in state or action vectors.

nodes.label: RMSE as headline metric
nodes.contributor: rationale: Capacity is normalized so R² is artificially inflated and misleading; RMSE first, MAE second, R² last.

nodes.label: Negative SOH predictions at end-of-life (open issue)
nodes.norm_label: negative soh predictions at end-of-life (open issue)

nodes.label: XGBoost high-frequency preference (open question)
nodes.contributor: rationale: XGB unexpectedly weights high frequencies, contradicting prior literature. Hypothesis: uniform charge/discharge protocol gives the action vector no variance, so XGB leans on high-freq features (possibly SEI cracking).

nodes.label: Capacity label extraction rules
nodes.contributor: rationale: PEIS-HC-RT and GEIS-HC-RT use Ns=8 (final/max Capacity/mA.h, validated by negative median current); sparseEIS uses Ns=3.

nodes.contributor: rationale: Develop interactively in notebooks/, then export successful experiments to experiments/<model>/<name>.py for reproducibility.
